title: Final Mass Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the rest mass of the composite particle as M = sqrt(17) m_0.

title: Final Velocity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the velocity of the composite particle as v = 1.7 x 10^10 cm/s.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of energy conservation by calculating the total energy of the moving particle as 3m_0.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply momentum conservation correctly to relate the momentum of the moving particle to the composite.

title: Invariant Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the invariant mass squared S = 17m_0^2.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the momentum or energy calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Gamma Factor Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show the calculation of the gamma factor and its relation to velocity.

title: Beta Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a clear derivation of beta from the gamma factor.
